candidates.function: Take a small sample and equal reference from your own food; split or slice the sample with your stone or flint edge onto a clean support in actual weather; weigh both on your teste
Lay a small open fuel bed of your own fuel, light it by hand friction or from a hot bed, feed, inspect or smother it; it burns on its own until fuel or air runs out.

execution.progress: Friction is worked and paid round by round up to durationRounds; an unworked round, lost reach or energy ends it, returning the worn pieces. Other modes take one round. Beds burn and cool every round unattended.

details.costs: Study 4 rounds. Beds are in reach within 0.65 m. tend, 1 round, 0.5 energy: with x,y lays a new 0.2 m bed (firm open ground, footprint clear, nobody on it), else feeds your own bed; takes quantity (default 1) from each own fuelItemIds item (inedible with fuel value) and tinderItemIds item (dry grass, bark, moss, reed); holds 1.6 kg. inspect: anyone, 1 round, 0.2 energy via probe observe. attempt-ignition on your unlit bed with 0.5 tinder and 0.5 fuel, inspected by you within 10 rounds, while you hold sand or clay totaling 2.01 kg named in extinguishingItemIds: friction, toolItemIds rubbing then base piece, whole rigid wood units at least 0.3 m long, rubbing 1.5-5 cm thick and not softer, base 3 cm+, durationRounds 1-5 (default 3) at 1 energy per worked round; hot-target, 1 round, 0.5 energy, from the bed at 300 C+ or a brand from your burning bed within 1 m. extinguish: anyone, 1 round, 0.5 energy plus 2.01 kg of your listed sand or clay (or quantity from each). Failed checks spend nothing.
details.effects: Water share is the represented one (branch 0.5, dry grass 0.4); only burning fuel dries. Friction: 1 energy = 21.6 kJ; contact reaches air+15(n-1)+contact*dryness*500/(1+0.5wind) C, dryness 1-water/0.35, contact rising as the groove wears; 350 C with 2 g dust forms an ember, which lights tinder of water <=0.35 at rain <=0.15 and wind <=0.65; wear 2 g a round. Fire: up to 1 fuel unit (2 MJ) a round times (1-water), 10% ash, embers 3 rounds, rain >0.6 douses, rain wets fuel +0.08*rain; burning fuel dries 0.08 a round; leaving or death never stops it. A fifth of the heat holds the bed, a tenth reaches people: within 2 m +0.6*burn*(1-d/2)*(1-0.5wind) degrees; on the bed -5*burn health; loose fuel and combustible stock within 0.45 m catch; probes in reach draw stored heat. Smothering closes air; the bed cools; inspect reads it. No cooking, safety or reward.

packet.access: Omission is not absence. Query abilities, own inventory, knowledge, projects, memory, state or personally observed objects in batches. Ability search/list returns compact catalogue entries; use exact ids for full interface details and applicability. Search results are indexes. Exact queries return one record per offset. All paged records use600-code-unit fragments with zero-based part0..parts-1, consistently in proactive and queried views. Current-scope retained queries are reprojected using these stable pages; original results remain archived. Queries expose no hidden properties, other private records or historical capabilities. Queries do not perform physical trials or award experience. Exact-id queries return a complete record of up to 6000 code units as one value in a single result; larger records keep the paged form. Paged records omit their per-record notes: concatenate all parts before parsing; continue with the same exact id. An entry marked inRetrieval is shown with at least the same content under the same id in this input's retrieval. observation.terrain rows are "y:x:cells" strings: each character of cells is the terrain kind of one visible cell, at x, x+1, ... in row y. abilities.baseline entries with id, function and args summarize interfaces you neither used in the last 25 rounds nor need now. args lists the arguments in order: a bare name is a string; otherwise its type with any bounds (number>=lo, integer<=hi, integer lo..hi, and a bare lo..hi is a number range) or its choices a|b; ? marks an optional argument and "" means none. An exact abilities query by id returns the complete contract, including references and string limits of 200 or more code units.

value.name: Air-dry food trial
value.function: Lay whole units of your own berries or roots in one layer on a clean, dry, rigid support to air-dry in actual weather, beside an equal carried untreated reference from the same stack; tend (turn or move), inspect, stop.
value.costs: Study: 3 rounds. start: inputStackId, your own unspoiled untreated whole berry or root stack with 2 x quantity whole units (default quantity 1); supportId, your own carried item with quantity whole units that is non-food, non-toxic, non-perishable, dry (water fraction 0.1 or less), rigid (contact-resistance index 8+, flexibility 0), unfractured and clean (no contamination, residue, marking or treatment record), laid on firm ordinary unobstructed ground at x,y (default your position) within 0.65 plus your radius; or an existing food surface in reach, not another person's, of at least 0.04 x quantity area; durationRounds, default 10. One round, 1 energy. tend: within reach of the units; one round, 0.2 energy; turns them in place, or with x,y moves your support and the units to a new ground point in reach. inspect: within reach; reuses probe observe, one round and 0.2 energy. stop: one round, no energy. All checks precede any charge; gathering, travel and pickup cost separately.
value.effects: Start separates quantity treated and quantity reference units from the stack with their tenths, decay, harvest time and origin, and gives both the world food water record (assumed water fraction berry 0.85, root 0.75). The treated units lie unowned on the support over 0.04 per unit, the support item held there; the reference stays carried and reserved. Each round the existing rules apply: whole food neither evaporates nor absorbs vapour, so it never dries; rain on an uncovered surface adds 0.01 x rain x area water; decay continues at the ordinary rate where each lies, never reset; nutrition and toxicity are unchanged; contamination is not assessed. Turning changes no represented food state. Inspect records elapsed rounds, quantities, both decays and their difference, visible shrinkage, wetness, spoilage and rain rounds, unverified; water is not measured. After durationRounds the trial ends with a comparison of your recorded readings, or indeterminate without any; spoilage, anyone taking all treated units, stop or death end it early. Ending releases the reference once and leaves the units and support lying at the site for pickup. No preservation, safety, refund or reward.

execution.progress: Each mode is one atomic round; the trial record persists and exposure continues unattended, without charge, until the interval ends, stop, removal, spoilage or death.

value.name: Beam mass comparator
value.function: Assess, assemble, test, use, inspect or dismantle a lever comparator: your branch beam across a stone fulcrum, a fixed seat and your own sliding reference piece. Readings give sample mass as a fraction of the reference and before/after ratios, as intervals.
value.costs: Study: 4 rounds, 0.5 energy each. assess (materialIds, supportIds, referenceId, sampleId, or comparatorId): 1 round, 0.2; reports each requirement met or missing. assemble: materialIds [beam: your whole untreated branch unit; optional fulcrum: your whole stone or flint unit, set where you stand on firm ground], or supportIds [a solid stone or flint object in reach], and referenceId (your non-food piece that does not decay, at most 1 unit): 3 paid rounds of 0.5, continuing; resume with assemble and comparatorId. test, compare: one reading, 1 round, 0.2, at your comparator; reading empty or loaded (sampleId: your unreserved item, at most 1 unit); approach outward or inward. inspect: 1 round, 0.2. dismantle: 1 round, 0.2. Checks run before any charge; gather, pickup and travel are separate; no refund.
value.effects: Assumed: a branch is a uniform 1.1 m beam laid at its midpoint; positions are fractions of the half-beam from the fulcrum (+ toward the reference), read to 0.02; the seat is at -0.9. A reading slides the reference until the beam tips: torques of the actual masses against stiction 0.005 m x mass on the fulcrum, so outward and inward tips bracket a null range. A test (3+ empty and 3+ loaded readings of one sample, both directions each) passes if each set repeats within 0.04 and closes; a new test replaces it. compare on a tested comparator: an empty check, 3+ loaded readings of one sample (both directions) and a closing empty check within 0.04 of the test give an endpoint: sample/reference = (null - empty null)/0.9 as an interval. A later endpoint of the same sample (followed through pickup, cutting or exposure) and reference gives after/before: decrease or increase only if it excludes 1, else inconclusive; a wet stone or flint reference adds 1%, other wet references are inconclusive. Rain voids a test; a fulcrum losing firm ground damages it. Parts keep their ids and return on dismantle. No grams, water, safety or reward.

execution.progress: Assembly continues each round; an unworked round pauses it, keeping placed parts, and assemble with comparatorId resumes after rechecks. Other modes take one round.
